scripts.install: uv sync && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.build:openapi: uv run python -c "import json; from artiq_http.api import app; print(json.dumps(app.openapi()))" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^Production mode' > fern/openapi/openapi.json
scripts.build:fern_sdks: fern generate --group py-sdk && fern generate --group ts-sdk
scripts.build:html: (rm -r artiq_http/static || true) && cd frontend && npm run build && mv dist ../artiq_http/static
scripts.build: npm run build:openapi && npm run build:fern_sdks && npm run build:plugin && npm run build:html
